title: Theme for the notes tool
question: Which colour theme should the note-taking tool open in?

recommended.reason: it is the warm light theme that was asked for, and every text pair on it measures above 4.5.

options.name: Warm paper
options.note: Cream page, brown-black ink and a rust accent; the warmest of the five.

options.name: Linen and ink
options.note: Near-white linen, blue-black text and an ink-blue accent; cooler and crisper.

options.name: Sage desk
options.note: Pale grey-green page with a deep green accent; the quietest, with panels that barely lift off the page.

options.name: Ember
options.note: Dark brown page, cream text and an amber accent; for night use while staying warm.

options.name: Slate night
options.note: Blue-black page, cool grey text and a sky accent; the highest contrast and the least warmth.

context.title: Kiln log: glaze test 14
context.body: Celadon over iron slip, cone 6 reduction. The breaks came out darker than test 12, and the pooling in the foot ring is the colour I was after.

field.label: Tag
field.error: A tag cannot contain spaces. Try cone-6-reduction.
